cases.source:
10 REM Monte Carlo pi estimation
20 RANDOMIZE 42
30 INSIDE% = 0
40 N% = 10000
50 FOR I = 1 TO N%
60 X = RND(1) * 2 - 1
70 Y = RND(1) * 2 - 1
80 IF X*X + Y*Y <= 1 THEN INSIDE% = INSIDE% + 1
90 NEXT I
100 PE = 4 * INSIDE% / N%
110 PRINT USING "Pi estimate: #.####"; PE
120 PRINT USING "Actual pi:   #.####"; 3.14159265#
130 PRINT "Monte Carlo OK"
9000 END
cases.output:
Pi estimate: 3.1376
Actual pi:   3.1416
Monte Carlo OK

cases.source:
10 REM Number guessing game (self-playing with fixed seed)
20 RANDOMIZE 99
30 SECRET% = INT(RND(1) * 100) + 1
40 REM Play using binary search
50 LO% = 1 : HI% = 100
60 TRIES% = 0
70 WHILE LO% <= HI%
80 GUESS% = INT((LO% + HI%) / 2)
90 TRIES% = TRIES% + 1
100 IF GUESS% = SECRET% THEN PRINT "Found"; SECRET%; "in"; TRIES%; "tries" : GOTO 150
110 IF GUESS% < SECRET% THEN LO% = GUESS% + 1 ELSE HI% = GUESS% - 1
120 WEND
150 IF TRIES% <= 7 THEN PRINT "Number guess OK" ELSE PRINT "Too many tries"
9000 END
cases.output:
Found 24 in 7 tries
Number guess OK
